caption:
Battery discharge, month by month. ERCOT: the month's battery discharge in ERCOT, MWh, summed from the daily cycle table, 770,026 MWh in September 2026, up from 338,301 MWh in December 2024. The direction holds in 21 of the 21 complete months after December 2024.

Checked five ways before it was drafted: 21 of the 21 complete months after 2024-12 lie above 2024-12's value; from 2025-01 to 2026-09 the change is 400,446, from 2024-12 to 2026-08 it is 458,659; from 2025-01 to 2026-09 the change is 400,446, 92.8 percent of the change from 2024-12; the change is 10.81 typical monthly moves (39,932 MWh a month, the median move between complete months); the floor is 1; 2024-12 holds 31 and 2026-09 holds 29 observations; the floor is 28.

The claim states a change; it does not say what caused it. the two ends of the series are different months of the year; every complete month between them is on the chart.

Source: storage_daily_cycle, as the ERW holds it. ERW table: storage_daily_cycle.
